persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.
bank.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
bank.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
bank.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
bank.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

messages.text: Could you make three different logo options for my cycling club? I’m excited to see some ideas because I’ve been having trouble picturing what would feel right for the club. The name is Moss & Mile, and each option should include that exact wording, including the ampersand, with no extra text, plus a small symbol. I’d like three separate square images at 640 × 640 px each, not a collage or contact sheet. Please keep the logos simple, using green and black on white. The symbols and fonts are your call, but I do mean three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts rather than just recolors of the same design.
